# Public API

Read and write your organization's data models and records from scripts and other systems, over REST with an API key. A key acts as its owner and can never do more than they can.

The public API is off until it's turned on for your organization; whoever runs your Monark instance does that.

- [Make your first API call](/docs/build/public-api/make-your-first-api-call): create a key, check it, and create a record from the command line.
- [Create a key with limited access](/docs/build/public-api/create-a-key-with-limited-access): give an integration only the permissions it needs, or its own service account.
- [Page through results](/docs/build/public-api/page-through-results): read every record in a model, page by page.
- [Handle errors and rate limits](/docs/build/public-api/handle-errors-and-rate-limits): retry when throttled and report what you can't fix.

Every endpoint, error code and limit is in the [Public API reference](/docs/reference/public-api).
